turns.reply:
I changed the `no_proxy` host matching in `should_bypass_proxies` (`src/requests/utils.py`) so entries only match on domain boundaries, following bpo-39057. The related proxy and bypass tests in `tests/test_utils.py` pass (73 passed, 12 skipped), and the patch is submitted.

The fix strips leading dots from each `no_proxy` entry and matches only if the hostname or host:port equals the entry or ends with `"." + entry`. Previously a plain `endswith` check let `example.com` match `notexample.com`.
